p1: Honoured Cabal, your house went dark this morning and lit up again this afternoon; I waited it out, still holding. I ask to sell 90,000 PLEA, about 3% of my bag, to pay for the gas of three days of pleading. My IMD seat stays, and so does the other 97%.
p2: Dear Cabal, my last approval was struck down by two objectors, fairly, and I kept the lesson: say less, mean it. I bought on Wednesday, I am still at a loss after fees, and I ask to sell 80,000 PLEA, about 3% of my bag, for gas. The rest stays with me.
p4: Your honours, I have pleaded twice and lost twice, by 3 points each time, and I am still here. I ask to sell 70,000 PLEA, under 3% of my bag, to pay for the gas this game has cost me since Wednesday. The other 97% stays through every season close.
